projects.title: Glitch lab (source of the Glitch pack)
projects.summary: The comps every Glitch template was built and verified in: RGB split title, slice shift, noise bars overlay and glitch cut.

projects.title: Glitch lab 2 (source of the round-2 templates)
projects.summary: The 8 comps the round-2 Glitch templates were built and verified in: glitch lower third, block artifact title, error cascade, terminal type-on, stutter words, RGB split mark, tracking band and pixel dissolve.

projects.title: Glitch lab 3 (source of the round-3 templates)
projects.summary: The 8 comps the round-3 Glitch templates were built and verified in: corrupted video title, scan-line news ticker, hacker alert, cyber sale, signal-lost end card, error 404 page, game over screen and chromatic logo sting (Screen-blended RGB copies).

projects.title: Glitch showcase (5.5 s sting)
projects.summary: A 5.5 s glitch sting: RGB split title, a glitch cut, and a slice-shift logo under a noise overlay.

projects.title: Glitch showcase 2 (round-2 templates, 23 s)
